title: AbbVie to Invest More than $200 Million in Puerto Rico to Modernize Barceloneta Manufacturing Campus
summary: Investment marks continued progress against AbbVie's $100 billion commitment to U.S. research and development (R&D) and capital investments, including manufacturing, over the next decade This...
body_markdown:
- *Investment marks continued progress against AbbVie's $100 billion commitment to U.S. research and development (R&D) and capital investments, including manufacturing, over the next decade*
- *This investment will support modernization of AbbVie manufacturing facilities and create 100 new jobs*
- *Furthers AbbVie’s long-term commitment to its Puerto Rican operations and workforce*


**NORTH CHICAGO, Ill., Nov. 19, 2026 –** AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) today announced a new $217 million investment to modernize its biologics manufacturing campus in Puerto Rico. This modernization will integrate advanced manufacturing technologies with artificial intelligence (AI) to support the production of AbbVie's current and next-generation immunology and neuroscience medications.


Work will begin this year, with the facility anticipated to be fully operational by 2030. As part of this investment, AbbVie plans to hire 100 people in Puerto Rico, including engineers, scientists, manufacturing operators and lab technicians.


“Our medicines are essential to the patients who rely on them, and our colleagues in Puerto Rico have long been vital to bringing AbbVie’s treatments to patients,” said Azita Saleki, Ph.D., executive vice president and chief operations officer, AbbVie. “This investment reflects our continued commitment to Puerto Rico and to strengthening our U.S. manufacturing network with the advanced technologies, capabilities and skilled workforce needed to ensure a consistent, reliable supply of medicines.”


With a presence in all 50 states and Puerto Rico, AbbVie employs approximately 29,000 people in the U.S., including more than 6,000 at its U.S. manufacturing sites and more than 1,200 in Puerto Rico. The project is part of AbbVie's $100 billion commitment to U.S. R&D and capital investments, including manufacturing, over the next decade.


“This $217 million investment by AbbVie sends a strong message about Puerto Rico and our ability to compete for high-value manufacturing operations. AbbVie is a global biopharmaceutical company that not only maintains more than 1,000 jobs on the island, but is also investing in new capacity and creating 100 additional opportunities for our people. Our goal is precisely to ensure that companies already operating here find the conditions they need to reinvest, grow and increase production in Puerto Rico,” said Governor Jenniffer González Colón.


With this announcement, AbbVie has committed to investing more than $2.4 billion in U.S. manufacturing over the past 16 months and creating more than 1,400 jobs in[North Carolina](https://news.abbvie.com/2026-04-22-AbbVie-Selects-North-Carolina-for-New-1-4-Billion-Manufacturing-Campus) ,[Arizona](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4670921-1&h=971995873&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.abbvie.com%2F2026-01-12-AbbVie-to-Acquire-Arizona-Manufacturing-Facility%2C-Further-Strengthening-Manufacturing-Capabilities-in-the-United-States&a=Arizona) ,[Massachusetts](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4670921-1&h=184949066&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.abbvie.com%2F2025-09-30-AbbVie-Begins-Construction-on-70-Million-Expansion-to-Further-Increase-Biologics-Manufacturing-and-R-D-Presence-in-the-U-S&a=Massachusetts) ,[Illinois](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4670921-1&h=2627853035&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.abbvie.com%2F2026-02-23-AbbVie-to-Invest-380-Million-in-North-Chicago-to-Further-Expand-Active-Pharmaceutical-Ingredient-Manufacturing-in-the-United-States&a=Illinois) and Puerto Rico. More information about AbbVie’s U.S. manufacturing investments is available at[AbbVie.com/Manufacturing](https://www.abbvie.com/manufacturing-investments.html) .
